formulas.description: Formula used to assign a stage number to the new stage value on contact record that triggered flow.
formulas.name: formula_ContactNewStageNumber
formulas.expression: CASE({!text_NewStageValue}, '', 0, 'New', 1, 'Response', 2, 'Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL)', 3, 'Attempting Contact', 4, 'Working', 5, 'Sales Accepted Lead (SAL)', 6, 'Sales Qualified Lead (SQL)', 7, 'Sales Validated Lead (SVL)', 8, 'Customer', 9, 'Unqualified', 110, 'Recycle', 111, 'Existing Opp', 112 , NULL )

formulas.description: Formula used to assign a stage number to the old stage value on contact record that triggered flow.
formulas.name: formula_ContactPriorStageNumber
formulas.expression: CASE({!text_OldStageValue}, '', 0, 'New', 1, 'Response', 2, 'Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL)', 3, 'Attempting Contact', 4, 'Working', 5, 'Sales Accepted Lead (SAL)', 6, 'Sales Qualified Lead (SQL)', 7, 'Sales Validated Lead (SVL)', 8, 'Customer', 9, 'Unqualified', 110, 'Recycle', 111, 'Existing Opp', 112, NULL )

formulas.name: formula_NewStageStringFromNumber
formulas.expression: CASE({!number_StageNumber} +1, 1, "New", 2, "Response", 3, "Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL)", 4, "Attempting Contact", 5, "Working", 6, "Sales Accepted Lead (SAL)", 7, "Sales Qualified Lead (SQL)", 8, "Sales Validated Lead (SVL)", 9, "Customer", 110, "Unqualified", 111, "Recycle", 111, "Existing Opp", NULL)

formulas.name: formula_PreviousStageStringFromNumber
formulas.expression: CASE({!number_StageNumber}, 1, "New", 2, "Response", 3, "Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL)", 4, "Attempting Contact", 5, "Working", 6, "Sales Accepted Lead (SAL)", 7, "Sales Qualified Lead (SQL)", 8, "Sales Validated Lead (SVL)", 9, "Customer", 110, "Unqualified", 111, "Recycle", 111, "Existing Opp", NULL)

formulas.name: formula_SkippedStage
formulas.expression: IF( OR( ({!formula_ContactNewStageNumber} - {!formula_ContactPriorStageNumber} > 1), ({!formula_LeadNewStageNumber} - {!formula_LeadPriorStageNumber}) > 1, AND({!formula_ContactPriorStageNumber} = 111, {!formula_ContactNewStageNumber} >= 3, {!formula_ContactNewStageNumber}< 100), AND({!formula_LeadPriorStageNumber} = 111, {!formula_LeadNewStageNumber} >= 3, {!formula_LeadNewStageNumber} < 100) ), TRUE, FALSE)
